title: Account for errors in reporting property, plant, and equipment

items.concept: Depreciation system error (useful life entered wrong); subsequent measurement schedule of incorrect vs correct depreciation; prior period adjustment; period-end adjusting JE after correction; disposal using corrected book value

Number-variant twin: ordinary repairs improperly capitalized; multi-year subsequent measurement schedule of depreciation on the error; prior period adjustment removing cost, AD, and net RE overstatement

Capital improvement incorrectly expensed (initial recognition error); subsequent measurement schedule of missing depreciation; prior period adjustment to capitalize cost, catch up AD, and restore RE; period-end adjusting JE after correction
Classification of PPE error correction path; measurement of net PPA when depreciation was double-recorded and partly omitted
